parts.t: Beach Grove is a neighbourhood by the ocean in Tsawwassen, with beaches, trails and a golf course. Browse Beach Grove homes for sale below, and contact me with any questions.

Beach Grove is one of the older neighbourhoods in Tsawwassen, on the Boundary Bay side. You'll find old beach cottages, family homes and newer rebuilds. Many sit on quiet streets with big, old trees, and some have water views.

Beach Grove Golf Club is right in the neighbourhood. Centennial Beach and the Boundary Bay dyke are close by for walks. Tsawwassen Mills, the shops on 56 Street, the BC Ferries terminal and Highway 17 are all a short drive away. Contact me for current Beach Grove homes for sale and recent sales.
Can't find what you're looking for? Jared can search the full MLS® for you.
